rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic devices that calculate nonpublic competitor information to advise on rent or occupancy; tenants may sue, with penalties up to $1,000 per violation, each unit and month a separate violation.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; up to $1,000 per violation
rules.quoted_span: S.F. Admin. Code § 37.10C (effective October 2024)Prohibits qualifying algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; private tenant claims and up to $1,000 per violation
